full_judgment:
Farah Mahbub, J:  In this Rule issued under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh the respondents have been called upon to show cause as to why the impugned notice dated 20.12.2005, issued under signature of the Officer-in-Charge, Biswanath Police Station, District-Sylhet (respondent No.3), restraining the petitioner from making any construction over the land in question of dag No.8230 of Khatian No.2239, measuring .24 acres of land of Mouja-Dashghar, Police Station Biswanath, District-Sylhet should not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 2. Facts, in brief, are that the land in question appertaining to S.A. dag No.8230 of Khatian No.2239 belonged to Jegerdra Kumar Das, Rajendra Kumar Das, Surjo Moni Das, Devendra Kumar Das and Girish Chandra Das. Devendra Kumar Das subsequently died leaving behind his daughter Bashanti Bala Das and one grand son through that daughter, named Makhan Chandra Das. The said successive heirs of the case property subsequently sold out an area of .09 acres of land of dag No.8230 along with other lands vide 2(two) separate registered Kabala dated 26.09.1989 and 18.07.1990 respectively in favour of one Illias Mia with possession thereof. Later said Illias Mia transferred the said land in favour of the petitioner vide registered kabala dated 08.03.1997. That Bashanti Bala Das and Makhan Chandra Das also transferred an area of .15 acres of land from dag No.8230 along with other land in favour of the petitioner on executing registered kabala dated 18.05.1998 with possession thereof. That thereby the petitioner in total purchased .24 acres of land in dag No.8230 and was enjoying its possession by constructing a multi-stored commercial building. Subsequently, the case property had been enlisted as vested property. The petitioner accordingly made an application for release of his purchase property from the said list of vested property which was duly registered as V.P. Release Case No.03/2002-2003. On obtaining opinion from the G.P. (government pleader), the Kanungo and the Tahshilder, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Sylhet opined on 25.03.2003 in favour of releasing the purchased property of the petitioner from the list of vested property. However, due to promulgation of "Arpita Sampatti Pratarpan Ain, 2001" the same could not be disposed of and is still pending. On 02.02.2005, one Abdus Shahid as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.10 of 2005 impleading the petitioner and his vendors as the defendants; Bangladesh, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet and other government officials were impleaded as proforma defendants seeking declaration over 10 decimals of land from dag No.8230 of Khatian No.2239. In the said suit the plaintiff had also sought for a declaration that the kabala dated 08.03.1997 and 18.05.1998 respectively executed in favour of the petitioner to be declared as forged, collusive, illegal and not binding upon him and also for decree of permanent injunction restraining the defendant No.1, the petitioner from changing the nature and feature of the suit land. The petitioner as defendant appeared on 25.04.2005 by filing an application under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint. The said application was ultimately rejected. Being aggrieved the plaintiff, Abdus Shahid preferred Civil Revision No.3398 of 2005 before the Hon'ble High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh which is pending for disposal. On 09.06.2005 the petitioner instituted Title Suit No.52 of 2004 before the learned Assistant Judge, Biswanath, Sylhet impleading the government as defendant for declaration that his purchased land measuring .24 acres of land of dag No.8230 of Khatian No.2239 is not a vested and non-resident property and also for permanent injunction. That subsequently allowing his prayer the court concern below vide order dated 27.10.2005 directed both the contending parties to maintain status-quo. Further, vide order dated 15.11.2005 the trial court allowed the petitioner to complete his incomplete portion of construction work. At this juncture, one Abdus Shahid suppressing the pendency of the civil suits concerning the self same property filed Writ Petition No.5057 of 2005 wherein Rule Nisi was issued. However, the same was ultimately discharged by the Hon'ble High Court Division vide judgment and order dated 23.08.2005 on the ground that the land described in the schedule as well as the writ petition are same. Subsequently said Abdus Shahid again filed Writ Petition No.6739 of 2005 wherein a Rule Nisi was issued with ad-interim order. In the said Rule the present petitioner appeared by filing application for discharging the Rule as being not maintainable which is pending for hearing. That while petitioner was enjoying the possession of his purchased land all on a sudden the impugned notice was served under Section 154 of the Penal Code read with regulation 252 of the Police Regulation, of Bengal Memo No.S.A.V.P.641/1(2) dated 20.12.2005 under the signature of the Sub-inspector of Police, on behalf of Officer-in-Charge, Biswanath Police Station, District-Sylhet restraining the petitioner from making construction over the case land of dag No.8230 of khatian No.2239, J.L. No.101 of Mouja Dasghar under P.S. Biswanath, District-Sylhet. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned Memo, the petitioner has preferred the instant application and obtained the present Rule. 

 12. With the above observations and findings this Rule is made absolute. The impugned notice dated 20.12.2005 vide Memo No. এম,প্রঃ ভি,পি ৬৪১/১(২)issued under the signature of the respondent No.3 restraining the petitioner from making any Construction over the case land measuring .24 acres of land of dag No.8230 of Khatian No.2239, Mouja-Dashghar, Police Station Biswanath, District-Sylhet is hereby declared to have been issued without lawful authority and hence, of no legal effect. The respondent No.3 is to pay costs of Tk.50,000/- to the petitioner within 60(sixty) days from the date of receiving the copy of this judgment and order.
